blocks.text: KYIV, Ukraine — Washington suggested that Kyiv cede land to Moscow in exchange for joining Nato, President Volodymyr Zelensky said in comments released Saturday, adding that his country’s relationship with the Western alliance is “back on the agenda.” Zelensky also warned of the dangers of Moscow’s push to redraw “influence” in Europe and said the Kremlin was “betting everything” on this winter’s military campaign. Moscow has pounded Ukraine in the run-up to winter, with Russian President Vladimir Putin showing no sign of backing down.
